tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250bla ma'i thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel las 'jam dpal pha rol rgol 'joms kyi skong ba nyes pa'i g.yul rgyal zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 1$0000300na mo gu ru ya mānta ka ya/

tshogs kyi skabs su skong ba bgyid pa'i tshe byin rlabs zur du mi dgos shing*/ gzhan du byin rlabs spyi mthun sngon du btang nas dbyangs rol bcas 'di skad do// hūm̐/ chos dbyings mthing nag 'bar ba e yi klong*// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i dur khrod nas// 'jam dpal he ru ka dpal gshin rje'i gshed// yab yum sras 'khor dregs pa'i dmag tshogs bcas// thugs dam bskang phyir dad pas spyan 'dren na// drag shul rngams pa'i stabs kyis gshegs nas kyang*// rgol ba kun 'joms brjid pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs/ khrag gi rgya mtsho mi ro'i rba rlabs 'khrugs// dur khrod sa gzhir mtshon cha'i nags tshal 'khrigs// drag po'i pho brang bskal pa'i me rlung 'tshubs// ti ra bam chen gdan gyis thugs dam bskang*// gdug pa'i 'byung po bya gcan khros pa dang*// ro langs ha ha rgod pas gar stabs sgyur// skar mda' me sgyogs ral gri mda' char 'beb// bgegs 'joms g.yul gyi sbyor bas thugs dam bskang*// drang srong rig sngags grub pas dmod pa 'dor// hūm̐ phaṭa gsang ba'i drag sngags 'khor 'das g.yo// mngon spyod stobs kyis dgra bgegs log 'dren rnams// hur thums tshar gcod drag pos thugs dam bskang*// zhing gi bla bre rgyu rlon lda ldi 'phyang*// zhing chen rgyal mtshan zhing chung ba dan phyar// tsitta'i tog dang mgo bo'i drwa phyed bres// ro skra'i rnga yab g.yob pas thugs dam bskang*/ khrag chen dug mtsho dbang lnga tshil gyi gsur// rnam shes mkhris pa'i chab dang sha rus zas// 'jigs pa'i gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya lnga// 'byung 'khrugs dur khrod sgra yis thugs dam bskang*// rtsa brgyad stong sbyar myos byed dza gad bcud// dmar chen khrag gi rgya mtsho dpa' bo'i skyems// ro brgya nus pa dang ldan ba liṃ ta// sbyor sgrol tshogs kyi 'khor los thugs dam bskang*// lha snang gsal zhing nga rgyal rtse gcig brtan// bsnyen sgrub las kyi bzlas pa chu bo'i rgyun// bde stong zung 'jug 'od gsal chen po'i ngang*// 'khor 'das gzhi la rdzogs pas thugs dam bskang*// bdud dgra bdud 'dul 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed// pha rol rgol 'joms mthu chen he ru ka

/gtum mo dug hrul tshe 'chi srog gi bdag /sprul pa'i gshed chen ma gshin dregs pa'i tshogs// 'khor bcas thugs dam gnyan po dbyings su bskang*// rtsa ba yan lag rdo rje'i dam tshig las// ma rig dbang gis 'gal zhing nyams gyur pa// rnam dag ye shes klong du bzod bzhes la// dngos grub rnam gnyis thogs pa med par stsol// dam sri bdud kyi cho 'phrul zhi ba dang*// byad phur rbod gtong rig sngags gdug pa'i dbal// mi kha smra mchu sbyor ngan tshig gi mtshon// lo zla zhag kag 'chi bdag bdud kyi dpung*// chag che nyam nga ltas ngan byur gyi 'dre// mdor na mi mthun rkyen dang bar chad rnams// drag shul stobs kyis zlog cing sgyur ba sogs// ji ltar gsol ba'i don kun myur 'grub nas// phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i phrin las mdzod// ces pa 'di nyid la mos pa'i blo gros brtan pa karma nyi ma nas ched du bskul ngor/ dus mtha'i rnal 'byor padma gar gyi dbang phyug rtsal gyis dpal spungs yang khrod de bī ko ṭi'i snying por bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/// /
